description: Demolition of existing dwelling house, Replacement single storey dwelling house (Part Retrospective)
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:&nbsp;<span style="line-height:normal">Design &amp; Access Statement, Fire Safety Statement, BNG Statement, 110 FP 01, 110 FP 03, 110 OS 01, Surface Water Flood Risk Statement dated 11/03/2026, 110 FRA 01, 110 HH 01 REV 1</span>

<p>The development hereby approved shall be carried out in accordance with the of surface water and drainage details, including the disposal of surface water, sewage and surface water attenuation and storage details<b>&nbsp;</b>hereby approved,<b>&nbsp;</b>and shall thereafter be retained unless otherwise agreed in writing by the local planning authority.&nbsp;</p>

<p><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">The development hereby permitted shall not be occupied until there has been submitted to, and approved by, the local planning authority, a scheme of hard and soft landscape works for the site. Soft landscape works shall include: planting plans, and schedules of plants, noting species, plant sizes and proposed numbers/densities.&nbsp; The hard landscaping scheme shall include the retention of the porous materials as pre-existing</span></p>

<p><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">The development hereby approved shall provide for a minimum of two cycle spaces. The cycle storage shall be made</span><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">&nbsp;available prior to occupation and shall be retained thereafter.</span></p>

<p><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">The development hereby approved shall be carried out in accordance the submitted site levels plan (drawing no. 110 HH 01 REV 1). The existing land levels on site must be returned to their pre-existing gradient levels to match those of the neighbouring land, and retained thereafter unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.&nbsp;</span></p><p><br></p>

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no window(s)/door(s), other than those shown on the approved plans shall be installed in the side elevation(s) of the development hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.

<p class="MsoListParagraph"><span style="font-size: 11pt;">No further demolition or construction works (other than emergency works
required to make structures safe) shall take place until a Construction Method
Statement has been submitted and approved in writing by the Local Planning
Authority. The Method Statement shall provide for:<i><o:p></o:p></i></span></p><p><span style="font-size: inherit;">(a) loading and unloading of plant and materials to be completed immediately outside the application site</span></p><p><span style="font-size: inherit;">(b) storage of plant and materials used in constructing the development to be exclusively within the application site</span></p><p><span style="font-size: inherit;">(c) wheel washing facilities to be provided to ensure construction vehicles are exiting the site clean</span></p><p class="MsoListParagraph"><span data-teams="true"></span></p><p><span style="font-size: inherit;">(d) hours of operation (delivery of materials, hours of which construction will take place on site and presence of workers on site) shall take place Mon-Fri 8am-6pm and 8am-1pm on Saturdays. No construction works shall take place on Sundays and/or Bank Holidays.&nbsp;</span></p><p class="MsoListParagraph"><br></p>

<p><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">Notwithstanding the details shown on the approved drawings, the development shall not progress beyond damp proof course level until samples of the materials (or appropriate specification) to be used in the construction of the external surfaces noted below have been submitted to, and approved in writing by, the local planning authority: </span></p><p><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">a) All facing materials and roof tiles;</span></p><p><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);"> b) windows/ doors; </span></p><p><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">c) Patio and hardstand materials, which must be of permeable paving</span></p><p><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">d)&nbsp;</span><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">all boundary treatments</span></p><p>The development shall be carried out in accordance with the details so agreed and shall be retained as such thereafter unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.&nbsp;</p><p><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);"><br></span></p><p><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);"> </span></p><p><br></p>
